# Municipal Ordinance No. 07, Series of 2014

**Isang Kapasiyahan na Nagtatakda ng Isang Kautusang Bayan para sa Lahat ng mga Magtitinda, Maglalagko na Hindi Taga Rito sa Bayan ng Pitogo na Kumura ng Permiso sa Ating Lokal na Pamahalaan ng Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon**

Kapasiyahan 232

## Summary

Requires all vendors and traders who are not residents of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]] to obtain permits from the Pitogo municipal government before conducting business within the municipality. Motioned by [[Joselito L. Jaranilla]], seconded by [[Felipe O. Livado]], [[Eugenio L. Esconia]], [[Adam M. Forbes]], [[Rubi A. De Asis]], and [[Archimedes D. Tarasina]].

## Key Provisions

- **Permit Requirement:** All non-resident vendors and traders must secure permits from the local government of Pitogo
- **Scope:** Applies to all types of vendors (magtitinda) and traders (maglalagko) who are not residents of the municipality
- **Regulatory Authority:** Exercises the municipality's police power and regulatory authority over commerce per [[Sec-143-RA7160]]
